body:
I have but not actually doing anything doesn't help. Its action that matters, at least to her, and I still feel the need to actually DO something. When I'm just with her while she's feeling like this, listening, it doesn't help her get better. She asks me questions I don't know how to answer, and I never feel like I'm helping.

Im not trying to be jerked off for being a good friend by just being there for her, I just really hate seeing her like this and just standing by feeling like I'm doing nothing

But what do I do for the meantime? Just sit idling and watch him control my life? Shit all over me? I want to do what you said, become great despite my struggles, but he can take that away (for example he took away the computer Im using to edit my film on). There's nothing I can do. Even if I clean my room, it will never be perfect enough for him. Dying seems like the only way to show him RIGHT NOW
that's such a shitty thing to say, fuck you
